changeSet.author: chris
changeSet.sql: UPDATE ref r SET metadata = jsonb_set(r.metadata, '{userUrls}', COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_object_agg(u.tag, u.users) FROM ( SELECT kt.tag, jsonb_agg(DISTINCT n.name) AS users FROM jsonb_each(r.metadata->'userUrls') AS kt(tag, urls) CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(kt.urls) = 'array' THEN kt.urls ELSE '[]' END) AS ku(url) CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT CASE WHEN ku.url ~ '^user([/@]|$)' THEN ku.url WHEN ku.url ~ '^tag:/user([/@][^?]*)?\?' AND substr(ku.url, strpos(ku.url, '?')) = concat('?url=', r.url) THEN substring(split_part(ku.url, '?', 1) FROM 6) END AS name) AS n WHERE n.name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY kt.tag ) u), '{}')) WHERE jsonb_typeof(r.metadata->'userUrls') = 'object';

changeSet.author: chris
changeSet.sql: UPDATE ref SET metadata = json_set(metadata, '$.userUrls', ( SELECT json_group_object(g.tag, json(g.users)) FROM ( SELECT u.tag, json_group_array(DISTINCT u.name) AS users FROM ( SELECT kt.key AS tag, CASE WHEN ku.value GLOB 'user' OR ku.value GLOB 'user[/@]*' THEN ku.value WHEN ku.value GLOB 'tag:/user[/@?]*' AND substr(ku.value, instr(ku.value, '?')) = '?url=' || ref.url THEN substr(ku.value, 6, instr(ku.value, '?') - 6) END AS name FROM json_each(ref.metadata, '$.userUrls') kt, json_each(kt.value) ku ) u WHERE u.name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY u.tag ) g)) WHERE json_type(metadata, '$.userUrls') = 'object';
